user.title: Venus Surplus Control
user.description: Pick the entities of your Marstek Venus (from the Marstek Venus Modbus integration) and the sensor that gives your PV surplus. Everything can be changed later under Configure.

data.name: Name
data.surplus_entity: Surplus sensor (PV production minus house consumption, W)
data.surplus_invert: The surplus sensor is a grid meter with import positive
data.venus_ac_invert: AC power is negative while the Venus delivers into the house

optional.title: Optional inputs and limits
optional.description: Leave empty what you do not have. Without a first battery the Venus is the only storage; without a forecast the first battery always goes first.

data.primary_power_invert: First battery power is positive while charging
data.modbus_entry_id: Marstek Venus Modbus config entry (for the self-heal reload)

data_description.primary_reserve_entity: Optional. The charge level at which your inverter stops discharging the first battery. The Venus then treats it as empty 3 points above that (at least 12 %). Without it, a fixed 12 % applies.
data_description.discharge_limit_w: What the Venus can deliver at most (Venus A 1000 W; raise it for a D or E). A feed-in limit below lowers it further.
data_description.feed_in_limit: What a plug-in device may deliver into the house wiring. Applies to discharging only, charging is not limited. The integration caps the discharge command and, on a Venus with its own PV, the measured AC delivery, so that PV and battery together stay below the limit. Check the rules that apply to your installation.

abort.already_configured: This Venus is already controlled by another entry.

inputs_missing.title: Venus Surplus Control: readings incomplete
inputs_missing.description: The controller has had no complete readings for several minutes and sends no commands (after two such ticks it puts the Venus into standby). Missing or unavailable: {entities}. Check the Marstek Venus Modbus integration and the surplus sensor, or pick other entities under Configure. This notice disappears as soon as the readings are complete again.

soc_unknown.message: The SoC of the Venus is not available right now.
